code_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code shown on the iPhone
code_error_wrong: Wrong code. Check the code on the iPhone and try again.
code_error_locked: Too many attempts. Scan the QR code on the iPhone instead.
code_error_format: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
code_hint: You can also scan the QR code on the iPhone with your phone's camera.
gate_pending_text: Tap Allow on the iPhone screen to continue.
gate_denied_text: To try again, scan the QR code on the iPhone once more and tap Allow.
gate_stopped_text: Start a new transfer on the iPhone and scan the new QR code.
error_network_text: Keep both phones on the same Wi-Fi and the iPhone screen on.
error_network_inline: Connection lost. Keep both phones on the same Wi-Fi and the iPhone screen on.
error_generic_text: The iPhone could not complete the request. Please try again.
download_all_note: ZIP files open in the Files app: tap the file, then tap Extract.
download_empty_text: Choose the data to send on the iPhone, then reload this page.
download_keep_open: Keep this page and the iPhone screen open until downloads finish. The iPhone shows the transfer progress.
download_resume_tip: If a download stops, tap it again — it resumes where it stopped.
import_contacts: Open the downloaded contacts.vcf, or in the Contacts app choose Settings / Manage contacts → Import → .vcf file. (e.g. Samsung Galaxy: Contacts → Menu → Manage contacts → Import contacts.)
import_calendar: Open calendar.ics with Google Calendar or your phone's calendar app to import events. On some phones import works from calendar.google.com on a computer (Settings → Import).
import_reminders: reminders.ics contains tasks (VTODO) for apps that support it; reminders.txt is a readable checklist you can paste into any notes or tasks app.
import_media: Downloaded files are saved to Downloads and appear in Gallery / Google Photos. For a ZIP, open it in the Files app and tap Extract.
import_files: Files are saved to Downloads; open them in the Files app.
upload_subtitle: Choose files on this phone. The iPhone puts each type in the right place:
upload_choose_hint: Photos, videos, contacts (.vcf), calendars (.ics) and documents
upload_checking: Checking free space on the iPhone…
upload_no_space: Not enough space on the iPhone: {size} free.
upload_all_failed: The files could not be sent. Check the connection and tap Send to iPhone to try again.
upload_leave_warning: Files are still being sent. Leave this page?
upload_keep_open: Keep this page and the iPhone screen open until sending finishes.
upload_done_text_one: {count} file sent. Continue on the iPhone.
upload_done_text_few: {count} files sent. Continue on the iPhone.
upload_done_text_many: {count} files sent. Continue on the iPhone.
upload_done_text_other: {count} files sent. Continue on the iPhone.
tip_contacts_text: Contacts app → Settings / Manage contacts → Export → .vcf file to the phone storage, then choose it here. (e.g. Samsung Galaxy: Contacts → Menu → Manage contacts → Export contacts.)
tip_calendar_text: Export an .ics file from Google Calendar on calendar.google.com (Settings → Import & export) or from your calendar app, then choose it here.
